facts.detail: You were in hospital because your heart failure got worse; salt and an anti-inflammatory pain medicine played a part.
facts.source_quote: Acute decompensated heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (EF 30%), precipitated by dietary sodium indiscretion and NSAID use.

facts.detail: Start spironolactone 25 mg by mouth once a day.
facts.source_quote: NEW: Spironolactone 25 mg by mouth once daily

facts.detail: Furosemide dose goes up from 20 mg to 40 mg, taken twice a day at 8 AM and 2 PM.
facts.source_quote: CHANGED: Furosemide increased from 20 mg to 40 mg by mouth twice daily (8 AM and 2 PM)

facts.detail: Do not take ibuprofen until your cardiologist rechecks your kidney function.
facts.source_quote: HOLD: Ibuprofen - do not take until kidney function is rechecked by your cardiologist

facts.detail: Start sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg twice a day, but not within 36 hours of your last lisinopril dose.
facts.source_quote: NEW: Sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg by mouth twice daily. Do not take within 36 hours of your last lisinopril dose.

facts.detail: Keep taking metoprolol succinate 50 mg once a day.
facts.source_quote: CONTINUE: Metoprolol succinate 50 mg by mouth once daily

facts.detail: Call 911 or go to the Emergency Department for chest pain, shortness of breath at rest, or fainting.
facts.source_quote: Return to the Emergency Department or call 911 for chest pain, shortness of breath at rest, or fainting.

facts.detail: Call the heart failure clinic at [PHONE_1] if your weight goes up more than 2 lb in one day or 5 lb in one week, or if your leg swelling gets worse.
facts.source_quote: Call the heart failure clinic at [PHONE_1] if weight increases by more than 2 lb in one day or 5 lb in one week, or if leg swelling worsens.

facts.detail: Eat less than 2 g of sodium (salt) a day.
Drink no more than 1.5 L of fluid a day.
Weigh yourself every morning after you pee and before breakfast, and write it down.
facts.source_quote: Weigh yourself every morning after urinating and before breakfast and record daily weights.

facts.detail: Walk as much as you can manage; do not lift more than 10 lb for 2 weeks.
facts.source_quote: Walk as tolerated; no lifting > 10 lb for 2 weeks.

facts.detail: Heart failure clinic visit with [CLINICIAN_1] on 10/21/2026 at 10:30 AM.
facts.source_quote: Heart failure clinic with [CLINICIAN_1] on 10/21/2026 at 10:30 AM.

facts.detail: Blood test (basic metabolic panel) on 10/18/2026 at the outpatient lab.
facts.source_quote: Basic metabolic panel (blood test) on 10/18/2026 at the outpatient lab.

sentences.text: You stayed in the hospital because your heart was not pumping well and fluid built up.
Too much salt and a pain medicine called an NSAID made it worse.
Start spironolactone 25 mg. Take it once a day.
Your furosemide dose is now 40 mg. Take it 2 times a day, at 8 AM and 2 PM.
Stop taking lisinopril. Do not take it again.
Start sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg, 2 times a day.
Wait at least 36 hours after your last lisinopril before your first sacubitril/valsartan.
Keep taking metoprolol succinate 50 mg once a day, the same as before.
Call 911 or go to the emergency room if you have chest pain, trouble breathing while resting, or you faint.
Eat less than 2 grams of salt each day.
Drink no more than 1.5 liters of fluid each day.
Weigh yourself every morning after you pee and before breakfast. Write it down.
Walk as much as feels OK. Do not lift more than 10 pounds for 2 weeks.
See [CLINICIAN_1] at the heart failure clinic on 10/21/2026 at 10:30 AM.
Get a blood test at the outpatient lab on 10/18/2026.

items.text: Usted estuvo en el hospital porque su corazón no bombeaba bien y se acumuló líquido.
Demasiada sal y un medicamento para el dolor llamado AINE lo empeoraron.
Empiece a tomar spironolactone 25 mg. Tómelo una vez al día.
Su dosis de furosemide ahora es 40 mg. Tómela 2 veces al día, a las 8 de la mañana y a las 2 de la tarde.
Deje de tomar ibuprofen.
Deje de tomar lisinopril. No lo vuelva a tomar.
Empiece a tomar sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg, 2 veces al día.
Espere al menos 36 horas después de su última dosis de lisinopril antes de su primera dosis de sacubitril/valsartan.
Siga tomando metoprolol succinate 50 mg una vez al día, igual que antes.
Llame al 911 o vaya a la sala de emergencias si tiene dolor de pecho, dificultad para respirar en reposo o se desmaya.
Coma menos de 2 gramos de sal al día.
No beba más de 15 litros de líquido al día.
Pésese cada mañana después de orinar y antes del desayuno. Anótelo.
Camine lo que le resulte cómodo. No levante más de 10 libras durante 2 semanas.
Vea a [CLINICIAN_1] en la clínica de insuficiencia cardíaca el 10/21/2026 a las 10:30 de la mañana.
Hágase un análisis de sangre en el laboratorio ambulatorio el 10/18/2026.
You were in the hospital because your heart was not pumping well and fluid accumulated.
Too much salt and a medicine for pain called NSAID made it worse.
Start taking spironolactone 25 mg. Take it once a day.
Your dose of furosemide now is 40 mg. Take it 2 times a day, at 8 in the morning and at 2 in the afternoon.
Stop taking ibuprofen.
Stop taking lisinopril. Do not take it again.
Start taking sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg, 2 times a day.
Wait at least 36 hours after your last dose of lisinopril before your first dose of sacubitril/valsartan.
Keep taking metoprolol succinate 50 mg once a day, the same as before.
Call 911 or go to the emergency room if you have chest pain, difficulty breathing at rest, or you faint.
Eat less than 2 grams of salt per day.
Do not drink more than 15 liters of liquid per day.
Weigh yourself every morning after urinating and before breakfast. Write it down.
Walk what is comfortable for you. Do not lift more than 10 pounds for 2 weeks.
See [CLINICIAN_1] at the heart failure clinic on 10/21/2026 at 10:30 in the morning.
Get a blood test at the outpatient laboratory on 10/18/2026.

verdicts.reason: Source says hold until kidney recheck; sentence reads as a permanent stop.
Back-translation says 15 liters; the fact says 1.5 L per day.

es:F9.text_en: Call the heart clinic at [PHONE_1] if your weight goes up more than 2 pounds in one day or 5 pounds in one week, or if your legs swell more.
es:F9.text_tl: Llame a la clínica del corazón al [PHONE_1] si su peso sube más de 2 libras en un día o 5 libras en una semana, o si sus piernas se hinchan más.

es:F4.text_en: Do not take ibuprofen until your heart doctor checks your kidneys again and says it is OK.
es:F4.text_tl: No tome ibuprofen hasta que su cardiólogo vuelva a revisar sus riñones y le diga que puede tomarlo.
